computed_from: data/processed/384/*.jpg for the P2 VALIDATION fold (data/splits/p2.json) -- these files ARE preprocess()'s own output, since src/data/build_cache.py produced them by calling preprocess() on each source image.
metric: std of the 384x384x3 uint8 RGB array (0-255 scale)
rule: processed image std below this cutoff -> UNGRADABLE (low contrast / overexposed)
